programme.title: 我推的孩子 #10
programme.desc: B小町預定參加日本偶像節,但必須決定誰將擔任中心位置,露比與MEM CYO都支持 佳奈,因為她是最棒的歌手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #11
programme.desc: B小町終於登上舞台。人群為MEM CYO歡呼, 露比以晚期的小愛般的魅力吸引粉絲,但是奈缺乏支持…。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #12
programme.desc: 舞台劇《東京BLADE》的排練開始了。阿奎亞將自己的演技也當作了調查小愛喪命真相的手段。然而LALALAI首席演員姬川的存在,帶給了所有演員極大的刺激…!?

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #13
programme.desc: 《東京BALDE》原作者亞枇子非常不擅於與人交流,看到這樣的她,身為她前輩的漫畫家賴子很擔心她去到舞台劇改編現場後能否順利應對,而到了排練現場後,她的擔心成真了…。

programme.desc: 剛一出了一道課題,要家人說明自己在二十三年前殺害妻子澄的真相,誰能做出最合理的解釋,便能得到優先繼承財產的權利。他的親屬紛紛試圖解開課題,琴子卻突然提出一個問題。為何剛一的小孩恰好都有不在場證明?之後事態迎來意外的發展。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #11
programme.desc: 為了探尋安妮莫奈魔力的根源,健一開始蒐集她母親的情報。但安妮莫奈並不感興趣,她的身體也發生變化…另一方面,馬洛來到健一的家中,他的目的是重建子爵家的財政並除掉索加拉姆。而健一也有一件必須告訴他的事情。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉絲。由於覲見國王需要時間,健一決定在王城一隅設置自己的房子。莉莉絲對健一召喚出的各種物品充滿興趣,並對他產生好感。兩人的距離感過於親近,被護衛視為不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法應戰!

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人終於迎來與國王的會面,然而卻突然被命令與女魔導師梅麗莎進行御前比試,並要對抗她所召喚的下級龍。健一也召喚出挖土機,與安妮莫奈等人合力迎戰,但有下級龍強烈的龍息和堅硬的皮膚阻擋,他們的攻擊毫無作用!

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #10
programme.desc: B小町預定參加日本偶像節,但必須決定誰將擔任中心位置,露比與MEM CYO都支持 佳奈,因為她是最棒的歌手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #11
programme.desc: B小町終於登上舞台。人群為MEM CYO歡呼, 露比以晚期的小愛般的魅力吸引粉絲,但是奈缺乏支持…。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #12
programme.desc: 舞台劇《東京BLADE》的排練開始了。阿奎亞將自己的演技也當作了調查小愛喪命真相的手段。然而LALALAI首席演員姬川的存在,帶給了所有演員極大的刺激…!?

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #13
programme.desc: 《東京BALDE》原作者亞枇子非常不擅於與人交流,看到這樣的她,身為她前輩的漫畫家賴子很擔心她去到舞台劇改編現場後能否順利應對,而到了排練現場後,她的擔心成真了…。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #7
programme.desc: 伊織等人看著雜誌上介紹的宮古島特集,對能在美麗的大海中潛水感到非常嚮往。然而不知為何,在時田和壽的邀請下,他們即將進行網球雙打比賽!由於潛水時有兩人一組行動的結伴制度,因此與託付生命的夥伴建立信賴關係是非常重要的……而這些只是表面話,實際上是想從網球社團Tinker Bell手中奪取獎金,以報伊豆春季時的仇。PaB的成員們能在比賽中勝出嗎……!?

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #8
programme.desc: 沖繩集訓的相關費用必須各自靠打工賺。但伊織和耕平的日薪工收入卻都拿去喝酒花光了。而壽倒是很認真在打工,而且竟然還是當酒保。伊織和耕平對壽在店裡展現出與平時截然不同的氛圍感到困惑。之後在店長的好意下,兩人也決定嘗試體驗酒保的工作。然而,這兩個笨蛋對雞尾酒的做法當然是一竅不通,還接二連三地調出了許多危險的酒精炸彈……。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #9
programme.desc: 為了友情(金錢),伊織再次背負起安排聯誼的任務。他打算拿「國王遊戲」當藉口請千紗介紹她的朋友。隨著奈奈華和梓也被捲入遊戲中,一場各懷鬼胎的攻防戰就這麼開始了。不惜這麼做也想要錢的伊織目前似乎仍未存夠集訓的費用。但他還是得湊齊潛水必要的用品,於是他為了購買器材前往潛水用品店。對伊織這些新手來說,潛水的世界還有太多他們不了解的事了。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #18
programme.desc: 妮可和久久換上巫女服,在伽羅的父親擔任宮司的神社幫忙。妮可在幫忙之餘,順便對用來製作紙垂的紙施展「動畫剪」的魔法,做出了會動的紙貓。而伽羅也立刻做了一隻鳥想讓它在天上飛,結果卻因為剪得不夠好而飛不起來……。然而,這張紙因為伽羅剪紙技術太糟導致形狀像是「式神」,並疑似因此創造出了不會消失的生命……!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房間時發現了小時候妮可寫給他的信。信上寫著「給MOI:妮可永遠永遠都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他將這封信貼在牆上長達五年的時間,並且每天都受到這封信的鼓勵。因為今天是母親的忌日,守仁獨自一人前往掃墓。另一方面,妮可、監志、圭護、見晴及來乙木家玩的音夢從妮可口中聽到了她與和現在有些不同的小時候的守仁之間的往事。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #20
programme.desc: 圭護若沒有看見新月圖案就無法發揮強大的力量。妮可看見圭護臉上浮現出有些落寞的表情,於是交給他一枚注入了「飛天魔法」的戒指,並表示希望他能使用。只要能靈活使用應該就能成為一種武器……於是圭護懷抱著這個想法開始進行特訓。某天,音夢找正在進行秘密特訓的圭護講話。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努爾將被稱作山之主的魔物獻給了萊利娜後,讓兩人的距離從原本的契約關係逐漸開始有了變化,卻也讓萊利娜的命運籠罩在不祥的陰影之中。薇薇安對努爾抱有好感,卻連點燃神殿聖火的使命都被萊利娜奪走而懷恨在心,而此時,有一個人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了聖火儀式被賦予了嚴苛任務,疲憊不已的她來到泉水邊,也因此救起了一隻溺水的鳥。但剛好在場的大神官希卡認為去救註定要死的鳥只是白費功夫,兩人因此起了口角。希卡事後遍尋整個神殿,卻怎麼都找不到那個對自己失禮,但又令人在意不已的萊利娜。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #84
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭賈絲大衛所創造的「鋼鐵處女」夾住後刺穿。他在逐漸模糊的意識中想起與亞連等人成為夥伴的回憶。房間正面臨倒塌的危機,賈絲大衛試圖逃離此處。就在此時,有一位意想不到的人物在虛幻之間出現在柯洛利面前。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #85
programme.desc: 亞連等人儘管擔心留下來戰鬥的神田和柯洛利,卻相信兩人必定會歸隊,於是加緊腳步趕路。之後他們終於抵達塔樓最高處的房間,然而帝奇和蘿特早已在此等待。亞連等人保持警戒,但在帝奇輕聲表示除了塔以外的地方都已崩塌殆盡後,他們掉入絕望深淵。

programme.desc: 努爾將被稱作山之主的魔物獻給了萊利娜後,讓兩人的距離從原本的契約關係逐漸開始有了變化,卻也讓萊利娜的命運籠罩在不祥的陰影之中。薇薇安對努爾抱有好感,卻連點燃神殿聖火的使命都被萊利娜奪走而懷恨在心,而此時,有一個人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了聖火儀式被賦予了嚴苛任務,疲憊不已的她來到泉水邊,也因此救起了一隻溺水的鳥。但剛好在場的大神官希卡認為去救註定要死的鳥只是白費功夫,兩人因此起了口角。希卡事後遍尋整個神殿,卻怎麼都找不到那個對自己失禮,但又令人在意不已的萊利娜。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #84
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭賈絲大衛所創造的「鋼鐵處女」夾住後刺穿。他在逐漸模糊的意識中想起與亞連等人成為夥伴的回憶。房間正面臨倒塌的危機,賈絲大衛試圖逃離此處。就在此時,有一位意想不到的人物在虛幻之間出現在柯洛利面前。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #85
programme.desc: 亞連等人儘管擔心留下來戰鬥的神田和柯洛利,卻相信兩人必定會歸隊,於是加緊腳步趕路。之後他們終於抵達塔樓最高處的房間,然而帝奇和蘿特早已在此等待。亞連等人保持警戒,但在帝奇輕聲表示除了塔以外的地方都已崩塌殆盡後,他們掉入絕望深淵。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #8
programme.desc: 除了飯店經營外還發展各種事業的音無集團會長・音無剛一要求私下和琴子會面。他的妻子曾在路上遇到劫匪,因此喪命。剛一對琴子坦承是他間接害死了妻子,時日無多的剛一希望將自己是殺人犯的事實詳細告訴孩子們。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #86
programme.desc: 亞連被強大的帝奇打到處於劣勢,雖然實力相差懸殊,但毫不氣餒的他仍挺身抗敵。另一邊,拉比在蘿特創造的夢境空間受到精神攻擊的折磨。而帝奇為了給亞連一行人致命一擊,打算發動強力的招式。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人終於迎來與國王的會面,然而卻突然被命令與女魔導師梅麗莎進行御前比試,並要對抗她所召喚的下級龍。健一也召喚出挖土機,與安妮莫奈等人合力迎戰,但有下級龍強烈的龍息和堅硬的皮膚阻擋,他們的攻擊毫無作用!

programme.title: 重啟人生的千金小姐正在攻略龍帝陛下 #1
programme.desc: 「軍神千金」吉兒被未婚夫王太子傑拉爾德陷害入獄並因此喪命,但回過神來竟發現自己回到與未婚夫初見的那晚。為了避開人生最糟選擇,吉兒決定要與未來的暴君,實則純真的鄰國皇帝哈迪斯結婚,並立志要幫他重新做人。重啟人生的千金,她的大逆轉劇就此開幕。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #20
programme.desc: 圭護若沒有看見新月圖案就無法發揮強大的力量。妮可看見圭護臉上浮現出有些落寞的表情,於是交給他一枚注入了「飛天魔法」的戒指,並表示希望他能使用。只要能靈活使用應該就能成為一種武器……於是圭護懷抱著這個想法開始進行特訓。某天,音夢找正在進行秘密特訓的圭護講話。

programme.desc: 圭護因為頻道的影片播放次數沒有起色而感到煩惱。他找同居人妮可、守仁、監志及見晴商量,結果被狠狠地吐槽「因為你的頻道不有趣啦!」。為了讓影片有看頭,圭護拜託妮可在影片中串場,結果被守仁一口回絕。於是妮可對圭護施展了讓他自己變成「女孩子」的魔法。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 聖誕屬靈教室:聖誕節的真義-活在上帝救恩中-張振華牧師

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

鳳凰洲際快車 (151225)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰洲際快車》是鳳凰衛視子夜時段的新聞資訊節目,為您帶來兩岸三地,以及國際社會的大小新聞、最新動態和局勢發展。

programme.title: 文化大觀園 (451)
programme.desc: 《文化大觀園》:節目關注中華文化中的大事件、大歷史、大人物和新發現,在紛繁的生活中給您清靜、雅致的空間,並通過我們的鏡頭去探尋中華文明中充滿迷幻、離奇的人物和故事。

programme.title: 鳳凰大健康 (364)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰大健康》:節目將由來自中西醫的健康科普專家和全球首個“智能醫生組成健康科普主持團,並將每期邀請一位頂級醫療專家作為嘉賓,集合中西的理論精華,配合妙趣橫生的人工智慧互動對熱點的健康科普話題進行權

programme.title: 紀錄大時代 (1352)
programme.desc: 《紀錄大時代》:紀錄珍貴片段,重溫精彩大時代,《紀錄大時代》為您精選鳳凰優秀紀錄片,把歷史再次真實地呈現眼前。

programme.title: 香港新視點 (484)
programme.desc: 《香港新視點》是透過訪問特區政府官員、學者、焦點事件的相關人物,以及採訪兩地的年輕人的交流團等,讓觀眾透徹了解香港以至內地政治文化,加深對國情的認識。

programme.title: 名人面對面 (438)
programme.desc: 《名人面對面》:主持人專訪神州各地英傑,旁敲側擊,使觀眾如親歷其境,與名人共度珍貴一刻,感受最細膩的時間。

programme.title: 築夢天下 (459)
programme.desc: 《築夢天下》尋找中外不同風格的建築、民居,道出背後的環境因素和地理條件,詳述生活於其間的人物,細訴人和建築之間糾纏不清的故事。

programme.title: 香港熱廚房 (67)
programme.desc: 《香港熱廚房》是鳳凰衛視中文台《解碼香港》升級版,資深評論員程介南先生,邀請香港政經圈共聚熱廚房,取時事當食材,以此喻彼,見微知著,以創意為廚藝,化深厚為火候,庖丁解牛,分析解碼。

programme.title: 近觀中國 (203)
programme.desc: 《近觀中國》:全新推出的觀察類紀錄片欄目。每一期以一名外國人為主角,遊走中國各地,以近距離的視角觀察中國社會狀況和中國人的生活。

programme.title: 我的香港故事 (203)
programme.desc: 《我的香港故事》:人物記錄專題欄目。通過每集大約15分鐘的精致篇幅,講述香港人的故事與發生的事。為全國華人觀眾,了解香港新的視覺。

programme.title: 笑逐言開 (608)
programme.desc: 《笑逐言開》是節目運用嶄新的多媒體手段和獨特的串連解讀方式,通過主持人現場脫口秀來演繹各類資訊,帶給您更有營養的週末。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻:環球新聞檔案粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 印度阿蘭穆拉的工匠, 抗絕現代化技術, 以傳統技術用金屬造鏡,因為他們相信沒有透過折射所反映的影像才是最真實

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芷珮到訪葡萄牙中部小鎮阿羅卡(Arouca)，住進牧場酒店，一嘗當農夫滋味，親親不同品種的動物，盡情享受原始田園之美。返回波爾圖，玩轉海陸空之旅。芷珮徒步攀登地標拱橋，大膽踏足距離運河65米高的橋頂看風景。期間暢飲一杯波特酒，「堅離地」非凡享受！參觀當地「材料銀行」別富趣味，室內裝潢用品款式應有盡有，可有助芷珮為家居注入葡國風情的靈感？意猶未盡，她再走進手製特色瓷磚店，參與手繪獨特瓷磚的工作坊。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 朱智賢、周奕瑋、張惠雅、王歌慧展開九龍東的兩日一夜拍照「打卡」之旅，穿梭鯉魚門的燈塔與石礦場、登上油塘的魔鬼山頂，又置身牛頭角的「志明橋」，無際海岸、碉堡遺蹟、電影場景盡收鏡頭底下！四人還登上酒店高層，遙望維港醉人夜色。九龍東廠廈林立，不少已變身休憩場所、食肆或工作坊。主持們品嚐法國盛宴，又走進路旁酒吧輕談淺酌，悠閒寫意！眾人還學製甜品香梘、月球燈、音樂座等精緻浪漫手作，添加非一般的藝術氣質。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 談到曱甴，谷主們都有不愉快經歷，瀅仴坦言更曾因與牠「親密接觸」而崩潰大哭。雖然拍檔們一致反對，汛文指曱甴也有好的一面，理據如何？汛文整理了曱甴的身體特質，也間接解釋為何牠擁有令不少人討厭的頑強生命力，如即使頭與身體分離，曱甴仍可存活數天。不少人會害怕曱甴飛向自己，這或許只是因為牠失控？汛文又提到曱甴其實喜愛乾淨。谷主們亦嘗試討論曱甴若在世上滅絕的利與弊，並帶來防範牠們出沒的貼士。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 辣椒掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 所有辣椒都有獨特的個性，無論它們原產於埃斯佩萊特、法國、韓國或西印度群島，即使它們看起來很相似，但每種都有獨特的味道和效力。從印度到泰國，廚師們透露了激發食物濃鬱芳香的秘訣。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 全城藝員挑戰一叮，力爭發光發亮！火辣拍檔黃瀅仴、吳兆麟帶來結合跳舞、戲劇、小提琴元素的表演，高難度旋轉舞步技驚四座。劉芷玲青春甜美，冀以跳唱向家人證明沒入錯行，惟觀眾似乎不受落。堅毅追夢故事，能否打動嘉賓啟動「復活之叮」？梁允瑜、王嘉慧、莫韻諰的舞姿被評似魷魚，兼擺甫士多過跳舞！嘉賓激烈討論下，Bob躺着也中箭……擅長街舞的孖八將戲劇融入舞蹈，呈獻實力和娛樂兼備的項目。他還獲妻女到場支持，好有愛！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 黎耀祥坦言首奪「視帝」是演藝人生最感壓力之時，要舒壓，他不聽廣東歌、不看自己演出的劇集，有何特別原因？祥仔為《殺手》操肌，愛吃的他如何平衡美食與鍛練，以免負上過重壓力？透過皮膚與外力接觸，可令腦部產生催產素，增添安全感，甚至有助止痛。按摩是其中一個減壓方法，可會越大力、時間越長就越好？有說按摩後不應即時洗澡、睡覺及喝水，孰真熟假？還有專家講解按摩四大手法的適用情況，以及中醫師介紹可舒緩頭痛的穴位。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練Yama姐姐再次到來，與小朋友一同「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。她利用橡筋帶引領大家做出拉筋訓練，以提升柔軟度。不過，教練提醒要注意筋腱痛楚，不可逞強。隨後，她再指導小朋友以深蹲、弓步蹲等動作，訓練下肢肌耐力，並逐步深化動作。「動物好萌友」環節，讓大家一探英國短毛貓「蓮藕」的日常生活。牠不時會舔毛清潔身體，也經常環顧四周觀察，展現好奇天性。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 絕境求生專家智悟在凱伊的照應下，與皮皮、米奇和金寶一起到滑雪場遊玩。前往民宿途中，汽車竟耗盡燃油，令智悟一行要冒雪抵達民宿。民宿由能源研究所前研究員沈武經營，他對能源節約甚為嘮叨，令智悟等人無所適從。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子一家今天吃壽喜燒，但碰巧雞蛋賣光，結果媽媽找到鵪鶉蛋代替。鵪鶉蛋那份美味，令小丸子對鵪鶉產生興趣。當知道鵪鶉幾乎每天都會生蛋，小丸子更有意飼養鵪鶉，讓自己每天都有新鮮的鵪鶉蛋吃。

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
香港中旅集團呈獻：新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 新一屆立法會選舉結果出爐，90個當選議員中，近四成半屬於議會新丁，各黨派原本競爭激烈，但選戰在最後階段因宏福苑五級火暫停，地區直選選情有無受到影響呢？除了迎來多張新面孔，平均年齡亦創新低，部分資深立法會議員棄選時，正正說說希望「交棒」給年輕人，策略是否成功？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 急尋走失愛貓的貓主，喜見網友發相尋獲貓蹤，豈料對方索酬由1000加至7000元後失聯，更發現貓照片竟然有異？有185年歷史的雨傘店，難敵時代洪流，宣佈年底結業，店主感慨之餘不忘分享保養雨傘心得。下週冬至盛宴令一家之「煮」大傷腦筋？包羅萬有的盆菜可合心意？留意節目資訊。工程公司東主經好友獻計，購入一直租用的貨倉用地，首期連一年多供款接近600萬元，卻驚覺自己竟然不是業主，過程中可有不尋常之處？

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 想到訪藏傳佛教名勝虎穴寺，徒步往返約需六小時。家英哥貼心為阿姐安排乘搭直昇機，從高空俯瞰全景。二人又「貼地」行逛帕羅農夫市場，感受當地人的幸福生活。阿姐搜購披肩作手信，家英哥等候時向幕後人員「投訴」？來到偉仔、嘉玲舉行星級婚宴的酒店，阿姐與家英哥寬衣享受熱石浴，還邊浸浴邊分享日常，家英哥透露親自為阿姐美容。夫妻倆趁晚膳回顧行程點滴並坦誠對話，家英哥接連送上「合影驚喜」，更邀阿姐共舞，場面甜美溫馨。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 健美運動是力與美的結合，幾名運動員細談項目在香港的發展，並致力推廣到大學校園。全運會、殘特奧會舉行期間，義工們各司其職地提供支援，箇中有何得着？另會聚焦殘特奧會的港隊戰報。WTT總決賽召集世界乒乓精英，展開男單、女單、混雙比拼，戰況有多激烈？香港壁球公開賽決賽於主題公園門前舉行，兩位埃及球手稱王封后。港九區D1學界足球決賽，聖若瑟書院、拔萃男書院上演宿敵對壘。沙田區小學藉電競單車賽，分享運動樂趣。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈獻：財經透視粵
programme.desc: 隨著AI應用愈來愈廣泛，香港企業如何可減低被網絡攻擊的風險。聖誕節是消費的黃金檔期，今年商場同零售業如何作出部署？

programme.title: 新鮮人#17粵PG
programme.desc: 家輝欲請庇護工場的精神病康復者做裝修，遭毗鄰歧視，幸定中心存正義無異議。阮盈被文生捉回家，求DY帶信給家謙。家謙發現韋文曾為自己的曲填詞，不無感動，欲相約向她道謝，惜收到DY帶來的信，阮盈竟要求與家謙私奔。家謙及時阻止阮盈偷走，並說服文生讓他帶阮盈離開一晚，家謙終勸服她到美國醫病。DY被文生斥責曾將阮盈的信給家謙，差點被革辭，DY找家謙出氣。佳君、家輝雖再次見面，但關係仍未好轉。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 急尋走失愛貓的貓主，喜見網友發相尋獲貓蹤，豈料對方索酬由1000加至7000元後失聯，更發現貓照片竟然有異？有185年歷史的雨傘店，難敵時代洪流，宣佈年底結業，店主感慨之餘不忘分享保養雨傘心得。下週冬至盛宴令一家之「煮」大傷腦筋？包羅萬有的盆菜可合心意？留意節目資訊。工程公司東主經好友獻計，購入一直租用的貨倉用地，首期連一年多供款接近600萬元，卻驚覺自己竟然不是業主，過程中可有不尋常之處？

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 朱智賢、周奕瑋、張惠雅、王歌慧展開九龍東的兩日一夜拍照「打卡」之旅，穿梭鯉魚門的燈塔與石礦場、登上油塘的魔鬼山頂，又置身牛頭角的「志明橋」，無際海岸、碉堡遺蹟、電影場景盡收鏡頭底下！四人還登上酒店高層，遙望維港醉人夜色。九龍東廠廈林立，不少已變身休憩場所、食肆或工作坊。主持們品嚐法國盛宴，又走進路旁酒吧輕談淺酌，悠閒寫意！眾人還學製甜品香梘、月球燈、音樂座等精緻浪漫手作，添加非一般的藝術氣質。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 談到曱甴，谷主們都有不愉快經歷，瀅仴坦言更曾因與牠「親密接觸」而崩潰大哭。雖然拍檔們一致反對，汛文指曱甴也有好的一面，理據如何？汛文整理了曱甴的身體特質，也間接解釋為何牠擁有令不少人討厭的頑強生命力，如即使頭與身體分離，曱甴仍可存活數天。不少人會害怕曱甴飛向自己，這或許只是因為牠失控？汛文又提到曱甴其實喜愛乾淨。谷主們亦嘗試討論曱甴若在世上滅絕的利與弊，並帶來防範牠們出沒的貼士。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 印度阿蘭穆拉的工匠, 抗絕現代化技術, 以傳統技術用金屬造鏡,因為他們相信沒有透過折射所反映的影像才是最真實

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 芝士是邪惡美食之選，在佐敦，芝士食法多多，新主持譚玉瑛帶大家發掘，還有甚麼最邪惡推介？佐敦區抵食之選，隨時一蚊雞就可有一碟美食！陳自瑤介紹四家專一的餐廳，鯨吞法式三文治、廣東滷水、海膽及火鍋配料。

programme.title: 關你家事粵
programme.desc: 54歲的Frankie原本從事建材生意，可惜後來與岳父因財失和，被對方伺機吞併生意，更因財困而與妻子交惡，面臨離婚關口。鬥志盡失的Frankie親臨節目，分享連串風波的來龍去脈。心理學家林玥彤、家庭治療師程翠雲提供心靈指導，助Frankie重整旗豉，修補夫妻溝通橋樑。主持看不過眼Frankie的頹喪形象，決定邀請造型師替他改頭換面，效果令人驚喜！藝人嘉賓單立文若與太太出現爭執，又會如何「拆彈」？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 「鰽白魚骨裝飾製作技藝」、「木雕刻技藝」和「墓碑雕刻技藝」同名列於本港首份非物質文化遺產清單。民間工藝家馮啟仁，憑祖父的口頭傳述，摸索到如何把「魚骨變鳳凰」，他親身示範如何收集適合的魚骨作材料，逐一講解各個部件的形態，並示範如何砌成栩栩如生的雀鳥。神佛像工藝師王燮祥如何把一塊木頭製成一尊佛像？他的三位兒子對這份工作的前景有何看法？打石師傅蕭海波八十年代加入打石行列，他何以會選擇墓碑雕刻這門工作？

programme.title: 成長吧！大熊貓粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦中國大熊貓保護研究中心四川臥龍神樹坪基地2021年新生的四隻熊貓寶寶及它們的飼養員們，以“視頻日記”的記錄方式，以全外景拍攝熊貓寶寶的成長過程。

programme.title: 成長吧！大熊貓粵

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 為了讓Meltic StAr與自身有所成長，莎拉正努力創作新歌，卻想不到好的歌詞和旋律，而陷入情緒低潮。就在這時，莎拉收到廣告與相關作曲的邀約，雖然接下了案子，然而莎拉還是沒有靈感，截止日期更逐漸逼近……

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 為了介紹寶石偶像和宣傳寶石選拔賽，黛雅頻道做了一個特備回顧節目。另一邊廂，奇蹟閃耀組與Meltic StAr等人談起寶石選拔賽與鑽石偶像的事，還開始想像鑽石造型可能是怎樣，試著透過設計平板呈現出來……

programme.title: 愛犬訊號粵日

programme.title: 愛犬訊號粵日
programme.desc: 這天，淺沼太太帶著約瑟爹利小花，向丹羽與未祐求助。小花有著吃飯時將食物藏起來的壞習慣，丹羽推測這種行為，可能是出於小花不想給家中小孩奪走食物，於是建議增加用餐次數，並與小孩分房進食，然而……

programme.title: 出走澳洲粵
programme.desc: 黃翠如、洪永城為「搵兩餐」，在市集外擺檔賣港式雞蛋仔，可是翠如的地獄級廚藝，嚇退不少途人。二人轉戰街頭賣藝，永城「呃呃氹氹」推銷翠如的書法墨寶，竟連長者也不放過？辛苦過後，他們挑戰刺激的環保飛索過山車，翠如更玩到「眼濕濕」！但讓永城最感驚險，卻是坐上拍檔駕駛的私家車……深入酒莊岩洞，享用超貴磨菇盛宴，滋味如何？他們及後來到維克多港，乘坐由馬匹拉動的有軌電車，感受陣陣海風；二人還會互揭「爆喊」時刻。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽和6號選購「啖啖肉」的米鴨及蟹肉之後，首先巧用磨豉醬、柱侯醬、辣豆瓣醬等惹味醬料燜煮「魔芋燜鴨」，再示範老少咸宜的「蟹肉豆腐羹」。如要去除蟹肉腥味，有甚麼要注意？「脆薑魚露炒豬肉」香脆可口，是自製小食的滋味之選。肥媽及後獻上中式甜品「桂花杞子大菜糕」，味道清香，又明目健康。粟米鬚原來可以煲水飲用，並有利尿、去水腫之效。另外，肥媽貫徹「煮好D 快DD」宗旨，融合兩道菜式帶來「雜菜燉鱲魚」。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽帶6號搜尋本地農場出產的優質蔬菜，還購得香氣四溢的臭草烹調「海帶綠豆沙」，清熱消暑。肥媽又以南瓜煮出變奏菜式「原個南瓜葡國雞」；要更添惹味香濃，除了注入椰漿，還有一種「秘密武器」！阿媽另奉上「鹹酸菜炒豬腩肉」，鹹酸菜味道偏濃，可怎樣處理？刺參、豬婆參多被拿來入饌，她這次卻炮製「蛋花黃玉參」，黃玉參又有甚麼優點？速煮環節「煮好D 快DD」示範「南瓜連骨魚濃湯」，怕魚骨的朋友隨時一試「返尋味」！

programme.title: 女人必學100道菜粵

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵

programme.desc: 所有辣椒都有獨特的個性，無論它們原產於埃斯佩萊特、法國、韓國或西印度群島，即使它們看起來很相似，但每種都有獨特的味道和效力。從印度到泰國，廚師們透露了激發食物濃鬱芳香的秘訣。

茶煲世家#53粵
programme.desc: Roger決增立襄理職位，屬意子東與家玲為理想人選，安排二人參加升職試。子東自覺學識不及家玲，大失信心。另一方面，家宜週旋在家玲與丈夫之間，不想偏幫一方，尷尬非常。家玲替公司接得大生意，子東發覺客戶不可靠，著家玲提防。家玲將訂單縮小後，客戶突告倒閉，令公司損失大為減少。Roger歸功於家玲。子東有自知之明，決在最後關頭炮轟公司行政弊點，決定另覓新工。開會當日，Roger當眾宣佈子東升任襄理。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#5粵普
programme.desc: 元娘病重，羅夫人帶著十一娘前往徐家。她臨終前求侯爺能娶十一娘，侯爺最後答應。嫁入徐府當日，侯爺要求十一娘要恪守徐家家規，當初蓮房之事不得再發生第二次。翌日十一娘便向徐太夫人請安，太夫人並沒有刻意刁難。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 菠菜含有豐富鐵質、膳食纖維，煲湯、炒煮皆宜。鼎爺今回以菠菜搭配牛肉、豆腐「滾湯」，帶來健康有益、消滯開胃的「菠菜牛肉豆腐湯」。美食「燒腩仔」只用五香粉、粗鹽等簡單配料醃味，但要令燒肉煮得皮脆肉嫩，有何關鍵？且看鼎爺悉心「教路」。除了一道道「鼎級」菜式，鼎爺採用的傳統煮食器具亦受到注視。鼎爺細說煲、罉、雲鼎的分別之後，奉上惹味功夫菜「三絲煀斑尾」。他煀煮斑尾前特意把其中一面斑肉切走，打甚麼「煮意」？

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 小兒外科醫生指出「腸套疊」即一段腸道滑入另一段腸道之中，症狀包括肚痛、血便，三個月至三歲兒童屬高危群組，家長宜多加留意孩子狀況。醫生還會詳析灌腸治療、微創手術等診治資訊。前「港姐」翁嘉穗早前以畫家身分參與國際畫展，她攜同畫作分享學畫之路。嘉穗透露誕下幼子後曾患產後抑鬱，幸透過繪畫逐漸走出陰霾。她又分享家庭生活，並支持商家丈夫參加《中年好聲音4》追夢。「睇餸食飯」，營養師陳國賓示範「酸辣大蝦茄子」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 逆齡偵探戴祖儀、黃庭鋒再到台灣尋求不老秘方，吸氫氣療程能把體內自由基變成水分排出體外，可有根據？生物系講師表示呼吸、化學品及情緒都能產生自由基，自由基有何利弊因素？並提供��抗自由基方法。佛山果園隱藏長生秘密，鄧佩儀、許文軒親身查探，竟與土壤中的硒有關？營養師講解其功效，細說對抗自由基與食材顏色大有關係。九條是非題了解嘉賓C君是否步入初老，齊來做死蟲式訓練核心肌群！肥胖導致雙下巴？專家講解真正原因。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#15粵PG
programme.desc: 美詩加入娛樂城擔任公關部總經理，為駿昇改善形象。美詩希望終止與柏義的情侶關係，以免影響前途發展。曦昕仍愛着柏義，決定重新接受他，提議一起離開澳門。家聰受荷官訓練後首日工作，豈料冠一闖進賭場，在家聰的賭桌下注，並連贏多場。林磊為挫其銳氣，擔任荷官與冠一對賭。正花不停收家聰的匯報短訊，弄得心緒不寧。賭場突然停電，老鼠遍地，林磊突然向冠一開槍……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子弄得房間雜亂，結果引來蟑螂，嚇得她馬上叫爺爺幫手滅蟲。後來蟑螂再度出現，終於迫得媽媽出手，炮製據說可以毒死蟑螂的硼酸丸。小丸子回到學校，驚見中村帶了蟑螂回來，更觸發巨大恐慌。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓兒時夢想是開辦補習社，現時成為升學面試專家，可謂夢想成真。他笑言讀書時是老師眼中的頑皮學生，感恩遇到好師長引導，以及父母大力支持，才有今天成就。他細談當年赴德國升學的點滴，盛讚當地讀書環境有助培養自主性。嘉賓亦有為寵物犬拍片並經營網上頻道，小朋友如想嘗試影片創作，他有何建議？他還傳授升中面試技巧，建議同學多留意時事話題。本集也將播放聖誕主題的AI生成動畫《胡桃夾子》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 父親節來臨，爸爸表示渴望大冒險，大雄不以為然，多啦A夢用「冒險茶」讓他一嚐冒險滋味。明天便是重要測驗，大雄下定決心用功卻動輒偷懶，多啦A夢用「交心木頭」讓他兩種心態變成分身對決。

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2702粵
programme.desc: 敢威出埠洽談生意，意外感染了當地疫症，被送回本地醫院接受治療。雖然敢威一切如常，但身體會散發惡臭，並偶爾突然發病，導致短暫癱瘓。由於某些原因，秀琴、天娥一度無法照料敢威；眼見其他人難以應付，二人決定親力親為，為此吃盡苦頭。敢威幸獲她們悉心照顧，病情逐漸好轉。此時，秀琴接報得悉力士在外地發生意外，必須前往察看，天娥遂獨力照料敢威……秀琴回來後，卻遭敢威責怪，更得悉敢威提出要實現天娥的願望……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#24粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)新計劃公佈後，SNK股價異常飆升……慧心與公開平台聯手追查幕後操盤的富庾基金。志傲傳回神秘訊息，揭3U園與SNK有關！肇華推動的「原始股」掀熱潮，慧心在SNK直播訪問肇華時，竟稱要插播突發新聞。慧心與家妍聯手多家媒體，要揭穿富庾基金真面目。肇華仍想操控輿論，卻不知自己已捲入險局。關鍵時刻，一位神秘人物現身直播，以志傲性命要脅，要慧心讀稿挺富庾！慧心於直播鏡頭前放手一搏，如何改寫眾人命運？

programme.title: 大航假期呈獻:玩轉桂林懶人包粵
programme.desc: 有「桂林城徽」之稱的象鼻山，坐落灕江與桃花江交界，何廣沛、林正峰帶薛家燕安坐酒店頂層茶座，歎下午茶兼賞山水靚景！桂林米粉拌入滷水、酸筍等惹味配料，變奏乾撈、加牛骨湯兩種吃法，食到「o雪o雪聲」先算正宗？夜遊逍遙樓、日月雙塔，也可體會不一樣風光。桂花之旅展開，從種滿桂樹的七星公園啟程，遊覽結合創新科技與藝術的文化體驗館、嚐味散發陣陣桂香的「桂花宴」，再入手融合桂花元素的文創產品，沉浸式感受桂花之美！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄(完)
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 大學成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰才是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.desc: 擅長解決問題的小學生彼得，在路上救了一隻狼後，意外展開穿越時空的奇幻冒險！勇者與惡龍、精靈與半人馬、複製人與隱形人……彼得與狼的精采奇遇，就此展開！

programme.title: 彼得與狼奇遇記
programme.desc: 擅長解決問題的小學生彼得，在路上救了一隻狼後，意外展開穿越時空的奇幻冒險！勇者與惡龍、精靈與半人馬、複製人與隱形人……彼得與狼的精采奇遇，就此展開！

programme.title: 哈皮樂奇鬧翻天
programme.desc: 哈皮和樂奇是鄰居，他們跟帕普和邦迪一起住在鄉下。哈皮和樂奇之間相處得很愉快，他們的生活充滿了搞笑和歡樂。

programme.title: 哈皮樂奇鬧翻天
programme.desc: 哈皮和樂奇是鄰居，他們跟帕普和邦迪一起住在鄉下。哈皮和樂奇之間相處得很愉快，他們的生活充滿了搞笑和歡樂。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了(完)
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.desc: A musical staircase magically appears in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take turns making music as they go up and down the stairs.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: Pan Lei, winner the China Literary Award for three consecutive years, wrote and directed this film about the lives and loves of a fishing village. It starred the glorious Cheng Pei-pei in her first film as a woman (she had debuted in a man's role), and her much-lauded performance won her the prestigious Golden Accolade Award from the International Association Of Independent Producers a first for any Asian woman.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Like legendary director Chu Yuan did so often and so successfully, Chang Peng Yi adapted this film from a story by Ku Lung. Following the footsteps of the equally legendary Chang Cheh, Chang also casted the majestic Ti Lung, along with "Venoms" Lo Meng and Sun Chien, for a spectacular showcase of mystical Martial Arts World's intrigue and consummate Kung Fu.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Mun undergoes a cornea transplant to correct her blindness, but ends up gaining more than the gift of sight. She shockingly realises that she is seeing another woman instead of herself whenever she looks into a mirror. Recalling that things changed ever since her cornea was replaced, Mun vows to uncover the truth behind her strange vision...

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: Ah Kam, a seasoned prostitute, gets locked inside an ATM vestibule with a thief. Both discover they are ill-fated in life and Ah Kam starts telling him her life story as a prostitute, from a teenage hooker to a PR girl in an upscale club in her thirties, as well as being a strip dancer, bar girl and masseuse.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Speed
programme.desc: Ty can't stop rolling after Skrap-It steals his master cylinder, so the Trux must quickly figure out a fix before he falls off the edge of a cliff

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Ooo Ooo's Jungle Drums
programme.desc: Raa Raa has found an infectious beat, and soon all the other animals in the jungle are joining in… except for Ooo Ooo, who just can't get the beat right. How can they find a way for all the friends to play together?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Topsy's Musical Stones
programme.desc: Topsy has readied the musical stones for a noisy game. Raa Raa has been left in charge, making sure that nobody jumps on them while Topsy reminds the other jungle inhabitants about the game. But temptation can be strong… especially when Ooo Ooo is about...

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Noisy Present
programme.desc: Raa Raa has made his friend Topsy a wonderful present - a noisy set of chimes. But she doesn't want them. Who else in the jungle might like a very noisy set of wind chimes?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Big Roar
programme.desc: Raa Raa finds it really funny that all his friends come running every time he roars really loudly. The other jungle inhabitants are less amused, they only come because there are worried about their friend. What is Raa Raa to do when he gets into trouble and nobody comes to his rescue?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Scritch Scratch
programme.desc: Raa Raa always scratches his claws in the morning, but his scratching post has fallen apart. He sets off to find himself a new one in the jungliest bit. When he does eventually find a new scratching post it is huge, how is he going to get it home again?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Hurry Up Raa Raa
programme.desc: Raa Raa has agreed to do too many things with too many people today. Will he be able to do them and keep all his friends happy? More importantly, will it make him happy?

Gabby consoles him and tells him it’s even better - now, they have smash cake! They all hold up a piece and pose for a picture.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - The Dollhouse Hotel

programme.desc: Naya takes care of a man named Leo (Rizky Fachrel) who can't walk due to an accident during illegal motorcycle racing. programme.desc: It is said that Fahri (Erdin Werdrayana) has just returned from traveling to the city. He wants to meet his girlfriend Tiara in the village. However, it turns out that Tiara is engaged to a handsome, rich man, and the girl even said that her future husband will soon become the village head. Then from there, Fahri, who feels hurt and resentful because he has been betrayed, becomes obsessed with becoming the village head. Fahri asks for help from a beautiful girl who owns a grocery store.

programme.desc: Raph's brothers just don't get him. He NEEDS to fight! He's good at it too, according to his new trainer Spuds. But even though they don't see eye to eye, the Turtles must work together to stop a rampaging Bebop and Rocksteady from wrecking the city!

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - LAD Before 10AM
programme.desc: Determined to learn the truth about Jack's secret morning life, Lily does the unthinkable and wakes up early. But her sleuthing gets them both in big trouble. Lil and her BFFs Anusha &amp; Debs fight to win the coveted trophy at Hank N Beans arcade.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Big Bad Bubble Bass Sea-Man Sponge Haters Club
programme.desc: Karen tells the fairytale of a nerd trying to steal an action figure from his three little neighbors. Squidward hosts a secret "We Hate SpongeBob Club" at his house.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Food PBBFT! Truck Upturn Girls
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Squidward try to sell krabby patties from a food truck in the darkest depths of the ocean. Pearl and Narlene have a whales' day out in the big city.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Say 'Awww!' Patrick the Mailman
programme.desc: Frustrated that he's seen as cute instead of evil, Plankton builds a robot to punish anyone who says "aww!" Patrick crushes the mailman, so he and SpongeBob deliver the mail around Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Captain Quasar: The Next Iteration
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Bubble Bass butt heads over which version of Quasar is better.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S2 - Time to Eat Cleanin' House
programme.desc: Patrick hosts a time-travelling food show. While Bunny's in Klopnod, the Star home becomes a mess.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - The Odd Father Long Shot
programme.desc: Carlos has to choose Carlitos' Padrino in time for his Christening, but will he make the right call? Carlota needs a PE credit in order to graduate, so she and Ronnie Anne set out to find the right sport for her.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Flock This Way Movers and Fakers
programme.desc: Rosa's family activity of birdwatching in the woods goes sour when Sergio gets mistaken for a rare species. Tired of not having a space of his own, Bobby secretly moves into a vacant apartment unit in the building. Feat. Lori Loud

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Slink or Swim The Big Chill
programme.desc: When Bobby finds out Carl can't swim, he offers to show him the ways of the waves! After begging Abuelo for some AC, the cousins decide to earn some cash at the neighborhood fair.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Karma Chameleon Team Effort
programme.desc: The Changs go on vacation, leaving Ronnie Anne and her cousins to look after Cam, the chameleon snake. Ronnie Anne and her skate buddies work together to show their coach they can make a good team.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Best Summer Ever?
programme.desc: Jack &amp; Lily are half-siblings living on opposite ends of the world both hoping to have the "best summer ever." When dangerous events forces Jack's mom to send him to live with his dad, the kids fear their summer dreams have become a nightmare.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Stair Wars Enemies a la Mode
programme.desc: Patrick and GrandPat try to pass each other on the stairs, leading to a ludicrous conflict. The members of the Star family each confront their own absurd rivalries.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Jeffy T's Prankwell Emporium A Taste of Plankton
programme.desc: Squidward's prankster dad visits and brings all sorts of gags with him (much to Squidward's annoyance). Plankton tries to get a taste of the secret formula by attaching himself to SpongeBob's tongue.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Smartificial Intelligence Firehouse Bob
programme.desc: Perch fights for his job after he's fired and replaced by a robot anchorman. SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward feel the heat when they become volunteer firefighters.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 - Sportz?
programme.desc: Squidward invents a new sport to get back at SpongeBob and Patrick for annoying him.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Arr in the Family Finders Weepers
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne is determined to help CJ get onstage at a Pirate Dinner Show. Ronnie and Sid have to decide whether they "borrow" money from a lost coin purse they found in the mercado.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Stress Test How to Train Your Carl
programme.desc: The family tries to help Bobby get over his test taking anxieties. Carl gets lost in the city zoo after sneaking away from his family, in search of Keyon, the Komodo dragon.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Meats of Strength Dead Ed's
programme.desc: Jack's new friend Beef invites him to a sleepover. Jack, a sleepover newb, freaks out over impressing his new friend. Jack &amp; Lil try to prove they're the one true local, enduring a series of bizarre quests in the local dive restaurant Dead Ed's.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Operation Dad
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne tries to convince her Dad to move to the city while he is visiting. With the help of Sid, she devices a plan that seems too good to fail.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Trojan Force
programme.desc: When Danger Force's fingerprints show up on crime scene evidence, they must break into police headquarters and wipe the prints, or their secret identities--and Danger Force itself--will be ruined.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - We Did A Bad Thing
programme.desc: When their secret identities gets out, Danger Force will stop at nothing to prevent their parents from finding out who is behind their masks.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 - From Dust Till Dawn
programme.desc: Chloe is struggling with her leadership skills, but when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.

programme.title: Henry Danger S2 - Secret Beef
programme.desc: With an invitation to Swellview's most exclusive restaurant, Henry decides to bring his boss, Ray, but finds it more complicated than expected.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - Mutantweight Title Bout
programme.desc: All of Raph's dreams have come true as he fights Rocksteady, Bebop, and Mondo Gecko in the underground Mutant Battle Arena. But he doesn't realize he's walked right into a trap set by Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons!

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Bubble Bass Reviews Patrick's Prison Pals
programme.desc: Bubble Bass reviews The Patrick Show. Bunny brings Patrick to prison for "Bring Your Kid To Work Day".

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 - The Incredible Shrinking Sponge Sportz?
programme.desc: SpongeBob must figure out how to do his job after accidentally shrinking himself. Squidward invents a new sport to get back at SpongeBob and Patrick for annoying him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 - Patrick's Coupon Out of the Picture
programme.desc: Patrick has a coupon for free ice cream, but he'll have to get to the store if he wants to use it! Krabs buys Squidward's art, but to make a profit on his purchase he'll have to get the artist out of the picture!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Snow Yellow
programme.desc: When Snow Yellow is deemed the "Squarest of them all", the evil Queen Karen seeks to claim the title for herself by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Race Against the Machine My Fair Cat Lady
programme.desc: When Mr. Chang's job might go to a faster train conductor, he has to prove that he can be just as fast as a robot! Adelaide wants to help the city cats clean up their acts for adoption, but can she help these grumpy gatos?

programme.title: Wylde Pak S2 - Dubu Jack's Day Off
programme.desc: Halmoni falls in love with a customer's dog. Rather than return him, she dog-naps him and goes on the lam! Jack volunteers to run the Groom &amp; Board solo, but when a pet snake causes chaos he must protect the other pets from the jaws of death!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Kick Some Bot Salvador Doggy
programme.desc: Sid faces off against Lisa Loud in the Great Lakes City robotics competition! When faced with a deadline and no inspiration, Frida tries to use Lalo's paintings as her own!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Ay Fidelity Cut the Chisme
programme.desc: When Bobby and Par are left in charge of Ziggy's shop, they must resist jamming with the shop's musical treasures. The family tries to stop their notorious chismoso Hector from gossiping all over town but can he stay quiet?

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Sidekickin' Chicken Silent Fight
programme.desc: After hearing about a contest to find El Falcon's next sidekick, Carl becomes El Pollito and tries to win! Once Carlitos falls asleep, Carl and CJ must conduct all their playing - and fighting - in absolute silence!

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP7
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Shadow Of Justice - EP23
programme.desc: Because of some transfer arrangement and several complicated cases, AICIP Au Yeung Chung (Bobby Au Yeung) and CUSP Tsui Hay-yi (Joey Meng) become collaborating partners. The duo have mutual understanding. Sheung Siu (Jeannie Chan), daughter of a logistics company boss, hates Au Yeung Chung as she is certain that he has caused her family to break up. Au Yeung Chung had promised the late Mrs. Sheung he would be tolerant of Sheung Siu.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP21
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP10
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP6
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP7
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP20
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.
